en.tagline: Routes Remotion tasks to the right sub-skill
en.summary: remotion-best-practices is a router for the other Remotion skills. It reads the request and points the agent to the reference that covers that task, such as creating a video, setting up a project, markup, captions, rendering, or upgrading. It also asks the agent to open Remotion Studio for preview and to leave user edits alone unless they are confirmed.
problem: A Remotion project involves many kinds of work: new videos, project setup, markup, maps, multimedia, captions, Studio, rendering, licensing, and upgrades. Each has its own reference document. Without a router, the agent has to find the right one on its own.

With this skill loaded, the agent matches the request against a list of cases and loads the matching reference. When a project can run, it opens Studio so the user can preview changes. It renders only when the user explicitly asks.
fit: Creating or editing a Remotion video with an agent
Tasks that span several areas, such as captions and rendering
Looking up current Remotion APIs and docs
unfit: Video work that does not use Remotion
Rendering on every change, since the skill renders only on an explicit request
steps: The agent reads the user's request and checks it against the routing rules in SKILL.md.
If the user asks to make or build a new video, it loads the 'Create a new Remotion video' reference, with or without an existing project.
If no Remotion project exists, it loads the 'Create a new Remotion project' reference.
For markup, maps, multimedia, elements, captions, SaaS, docs, licensing, or upgrades, it loads the matching reference.
When creating or editing a video, it opens Studio with `npx remotion studio`, or with `npx remotion studio --no-open` when using an in-app browser.
It renders only when the user is explicit, for example 'Render the video', 'Export', or 'Give me the MP4'.

zh.tagline: 为 Remotion 任务指向对应的子技能
zh.summary: remotion-best-practices 是其他 Remotion 技能的路由入口。它根据用户的请求，引导智能体读取对应的参考文档，例如创建视频、搭建项目、编写标记、字幕、渲染或升级。它还要求智能体在项目可运行时打开 Remotion Studio 预览，并且在没有确认前不覆盖用户的改动。
problem: Remotion 项目会涉及很多类型的工作：新建视频、项目搭建、标记编写、地图、多媒体、字幕、Studio、渲染、授权和升级。每类工作都有各自的参考文档。如果没有路由，智能体需要自己找到正确的文档。
加载这个技能后，智能体会把请求与一组情况做匹配，并读取对应的参考文档。项目可以运行时，它会打开 Studio，方便用户预览修改。只有用户明确要求时，它才会渲染。
fit: 用智能体创建或编辑 Remotion 视频
跨越多个领域的任务，例如字幕加渲染
查询最新的 Remotion API 和文档
unfit: 不使用 Remotion 的视频工作
希望每次修改都自动渲染的情况，因为该技能只在用户明确要求时才渲染
steps: 智能体读取用户的请求，并对照 SKILL.md 中的路由规则进行判断。
如果用户要求制作或构建新视频，它会加载“Create a new Remotion video”参考，无论是否已有项目。
如果不存在 Remotion 项目，它会加载“Create a new Remotion project”参考。
涉及标记、地图、多媒体、元素、字幕、SaaS、文档、授权或升级时，它会加载对应的参考。
创建或编辑视频时，它会运行 `npx remotion studio` 打开 Studio；如果使用应用内浏览器，则运行 `npx remotion studio --no-open`。
只有用户明确提出时才渲染，例如“Render the video”、“Export”或“Give me the MP4”。
